_comment: AML vendor mock rules (ticket 123, FRS EXT-05, MCK-03). A transaction above alertAboveMinor poisha is an ALERT on the payer; a wallet or MSISDN party on the watch-list is a HOLD on it; one ending blockSuffix is a BLOCK on it. One response line per flagged transaction, the strongest action wins (BLOCK, then HOLD, then ALERT). Test data only.
